name: innova-seguridad
description: Pruebas de seguridad (reglas + app contra emuladores). No tocan la base real.

scripts.test: cd .. && env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u http_proxy npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-innova "node seguridad/reglas.test.mjs"
scripts.test:app: cd .. && env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u http_proxy npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project innovacontratistas-434d2 "bash seguridad/e2e.sh"
scripts.test:storage: cd .. && env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u http_proxy npx firebase emulators:exec --only storage --project demo-innova "node seguridad/storage.test.mjs"
scripts.test:play: cd .. && env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u http_proxy PLAY_API_SIMULADA=http://127.0.0.1:9311 npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project innovacontratistas-434d2 "node seguridad/play.test.mjs"
scripts.test:pago: cd .. && env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u http_proxy npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-innova "node seguridad/pagoEnLinea.test.mjs"
scripts.test:whatsapp: cd .. && env -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u http_proxy npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-innova "node seguridad/whatsapp.test.mjs"
